stories.title: ‘How does space smell?’ Halifax students connect with Canadian astronaut aboard ISS
stories.summary: High school students in Halifax enjoyed the rare opportunity to chat with Canadian astronaut Joshua Kutryk, direct from the International Space Station.

stories.title: Halifax council backs long-term strategy for fire services as population grows
stories.summary: The Halifax Professional Fire Fighters Union is praising Halifax council for taking steps to develop a long-term service and resource strategy.

stories.title: N.S. RCMP say they’ve stopped a man who allegedly went on a two-week crime spree
stories.summary: Police in Nova Scotia say a 29-year-old man is facing multiple charges after allegedly going on a two-week crime spree across the southwest part of the province.

stories.title: Four arrested, 220 charges laid in Cape Breton organized crime probe
stories.summary: The Cape Breton police probe began in July 2025 when police were called to find a stolen vehicle that was tracked to a property in Florence, N.S.

stories.title: N.S. municipal politicians weigh in on whether AI can speed up housing approvals
stories.summary: Municipal politicians in Nova Scotia are reacting after the federal government pitched artificial intelligence as a way of speeding up housing approvals.

stories.title: Truro deer cull to provide locally-sourced meat for food banks thanks to $30K grant
stories.summary: Nova Scotia is offering a one-time grant of $30,000 to help fund a program that donates locally-sourced meat to food banks, while also supporting Truro's annual deer cull.

stories.title: Halifax-area teacher charged in child luring investigation
stories.summary: A 33-year-old man has been charged in connection with a child luring investigation. Police say they believe there are other victims who were targeted online.

stories.title: Remembrance Day ceremony in New Ross steeped in military tradition
stories.summary: About 300 people gathered around what's considered Nova Scotia's oldest cenotaph this Remembrance Day to pay tribute to the men and women who served and died in the line of duty.

stories.title: Intimate partner violence up 15% over 8 years in Canada, StatCan says
stories.summary: Intimate partner violence rates are rising across the country, according to Statistics Canada, following an influx of what some experts are calling "anti-feminist backlash."

stories.title: Atlantic Canadian padres honour Wainwright soldiers in Remembrance Day speeches
stories.summary: Two padres in Atlantic Canada led their Remembrance Day speeches on Wednesday with reflections on the recent deadly fire at CFB Wainwright, in Alberta.
